title: Britain's sunless valleys
excerpt: On the shortest day the sun barely clears the horizon, and hills hide it. I drew the winter sun across the skyline of every town and village in the UK: 64 get no direct sun at all on 21 December, and Kinlochleven goes 109 days without it.
seo_description: Which places in Britain get no winter sun? From 90 m terrain, 64 UK settlements see no direct sun on 21 December.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Britain's sunless valleys' in black and red lettering beside a map of Britain shaded amber to violet where hills block the winter sun, with the line 64 settlements get no direct sun on the shortest day.
